Reviews for **Cheers Restore** (an after-alcohol supplement featuring DHM, L-cysteine, and milk thistle) are generally positive, with average ratings around **4.3 to 4.7 out of 5 stars** across major retailers and brand pages. Most users say it takes the edge off the next morning rather than acting as a complete cure.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXsx_nQ1IQXaQTp3W5vTI8z-ndhTGBMqOJ47LiOuJbv-UnkX9iI_HVFAyMgTqk8KDJSh4grr_7zl9qWAjCbHjIVMYZIOX_zCvk1PwIpsUhxQhigeYBFdW9B5vSTA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXe7IjoPsStnUngF0goq06dfZ9G8V0qvXL-41p9mGhG5SdaelYr5rV7p7eIPWMbW-xT7butA7XFT_0rl0csMvnYB1G9JOe1jYD5poVK62LAY9z-du41VjIF_mjwuungaWaq02zmIjbq2ewlA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXtc9HhcWeK2-QgJYrDoC-qFwP_PUYk6MJlGOBP8jU0lyKCWmVEXNPXWp8GL15ny0cER-Gc4mQhYJiPpoOkVfhg-sBuCujYa-opbRqD6m55q2RgXOArm0WFzFY9p4)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDosUV-BB9GytMgnblASuKj601zePlvWwmT9BqVAU4l4bxtqKuzAQHVy-S6Z-d2OS7kf5GcpOwaJW6Iz0DL-BT7SNNrQud9lN6JoxxV3ZMTrTy25VjZEvxa3qxRMvMGp_pUWQyb0piUc)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXNnwGLp4XzIszgs0_b0hKVr2dvjnJ9fu0CdwVoXAmeXcj1n88LnlcN-yhwFCmtGgpGtTA55Bi5PcY1zv34NzoWVuyJki6CxYq9rMFeFY_tDqw91fMgGWgHAWh94I8i-iVqF9I9Eq2hQ7pvaQL01zWgohjLA)

### What Reviewers Like

- **Milder mornings:** Many buyers report waking up less groggy or feeling like they drank less than they actually did, especially after moderate drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXe7IjoPsStnUngF0goq06dfZ9G8V0qvXL-41p9mGhG5SdaelYr5rV7p7eIPWMbW-xT7butA7XFT_0rl0csMvnYB1G9JOe1jYD5poVK62LAY9z-du41VjIF_mjwuungaWaq02zmIjbq2ewlA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDosUV-BB9GytMgnblASuKj601zePlvWwmT9BqVAU4l4bxtqKuzAQHVy-S6Z-d2OS7kf5GcpOwaJW6Iz0DL-BT7SNNrQud9lN6JoxxV3ZMTrTy25VjZEvxa3qxRMvMGp_pUWQyb0piUc)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXNnwGLp4XzIszgs0_b0hKVr2dvjnJ9fu0CdwVoXAmeXcj1n88LnlcN-yhwFCmtGgpGtTA55Bi5PcY1zv34NzoWVuyJki6CxYq9rMFeFY_tDqw91fMgGWgHAWh94I8i-iVqF9I9Eq2hQ7pvaQL01zWgohjLA)
- **Better sleep:** Several reviewers note fewer middle-of-the-night wakeups or less restlessness after taking it before bed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXe7IjoPsStnUngF0goq06dfZ9G8V0qvXL-41p9mGhG5SdaelYr5rV7p7eIPWMbW-xT7butA7XFT_0rl0csMvnYB1G9JOe1jYD5poVK62LAY9z-du41VjIF_mjwuungaWaq02zmIjbq2ewlA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXPUwfrZDduQfP_BJhBUuMLFbpa7si4wjlm_pxzCzq4JiRu88-i05NRUATGCmDOlPj2IsvyibL0dN7zbdLrSzPGeDGPG6Ps7IszO6AMVrY_5nHo1noH60dIrUHDzY5M--By88wX-zh_w)
- **Ingredient formula:** Reviewers highlight dihydromyricetin (DHM) and L-cysteine aimed at supporting alcohol metabolism and liver health without relying on acetaminophen or caffeine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXsx_nQ1IQXaQTp3W5vTI8z-ndhTGBMqOJ47LiOuJbv-UnkX9iI_HVFAyMgTqk8KDJSh4grr_7zl9qWAjCbHjIVMYZIOX_zCvk1PwIpsUhxQhigeYBFdW9B5vSTA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXPUwfrZDduQfP_BJhBUuMLFbpa7si4wjlm_pxzCzq4JiRu88-i05NRUATGCmDOlPj2IsvyibL0dN7zbdLrSzPGeDGPG6Ps7IszO6AMVrY_5nHo1noH60dIrUHDzY5M--By88wX-zh_w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXjmMUcXY73AWrwTK7MVs9qMPRIEK_xNizirEpxSf30_ZI5b391QMefLS0o540TPGSiDz2Vsc3AdFVai5gSpvqH3XscglqYHKAJy8wUHR7KqZrv5jUWdGV9OZbiowTmyN9Bd3OKhQ2-g)
- **Wide availability & guarantees:** Available in multi-dose packs and single doses online and in stores, often backed by return or satisfaction guarantees.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXsx_nQ1IQXaQTp3W5vTI8z-ndhTGBMqOJ47LiOuJbv-UnkX9iI_HVFAyMgTqk8KDJSh4grr_7zl9qWAjCbHjIVMYZIOX_zCvk1PwIpsUhxQhigeYBFdW9B5vSTA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXe7IjoPsStnUngF0goq06dfZ9G8V0qvXL-41p9mGhG5SdaelYr5rV7p7eIPWMbW-xT7butA7XFT_0rl0csMvnYB1G9JOe1jYD5poVK62LAY9z-du41VjIF_mjwuungaWaq02zmIjbq2ewlA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXNnwGLp4XzIszgs0_b0hKVr2dvjnJ9fu0CdwVoXAmeXcj1n88LnlcN-yhwFCmtGgpGtTA55Bi5PcY1zv34NzoWVuyJki6CxYq9rMFeFY_tDqw91fMgGWgHAWh94I8i-iVqF9I9Eq2hQ7pvaQL01zWgohjLA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXPUwfrZDduQfP_BJhBUuMLFbpa7si4wjlm_pxzCzq4JiRu88-i05NRUATGCmDOlPj2IsvyibL0dN7zbdLrSzPGeDGPG6Ps7IszO6AMVrY_5nHo1noH60dIrUHDzY5M--By88wX-zh_w)

### Common Drawbacks & Mixed Feedback

- **Not a miracle fix:** It won't completely erase a hangover, especially after heavy drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXe7IjoPsStnUngF0goq06dfZ9G8V0qvXL-41p9mGhG5SdaelYr5rV7p7eIPWMbW-xT7butA7XFT_0rl0csMvnYB1G9JOe1jYD5poVK62LAY9z-du41VjIF_mjwuungaWaq02zmIjbq2ewlA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF16A3G8SuyPqjt5Ec7WwIiBL5DoTI4ytvE93Lq4xnrZVyWmE01FGxPXsr8Y_KBfUdOylDwFHA4Dvxe1FNP-kUFtuqHMW9JOcr152jxuFDps99bSYRGQuJrjJbcYEpbCkrRt5vV_8OQvJgnzlEmJpfX7P7txIvwL2JNhLCQ1-JwLgKXeYgxFULP99y87is2-4)
- **Inconsistent results:** Some reviewers still experience headaches, sluggishness, or nausea the next day.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDosUV-BB9GytMgnblASuKj601zePlvWwmT9BqVAU4l4bxtqKuzAQHVy-S6Z-d2OS7kf5GcpOwaJW6Iz0DL-BT7SNNrQud9lN6JoxxV3ZMTrTy25VjZEvxa3qxRMvMGp_pUWQyb0piUc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXYXtOXZzHSGvTI58F7GWA_PVLGjpZK9uzQbvZMqwCvOjXwAQcEMGyPW17jtw0cZH4B6yS1W3VhuGLOjSgQKbZM6jhMpfT9PPsRQnOkuTWByg7akbfvCcavOXpCNg1Hoz1kZtlECHH)
- **Price per dose:** Costs vary depending on where you buy (roughly $3 to $5 per dose depending on pack size and retailer).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXsx_nQ1IQXaQTp3W5vTI8z-ndhTGBMqOJ47LiOuJbv-UnkX9iI_HVFAyMgTqk8KDJSh4grr_7zl9qWAjCbHjIVMYZIOX_zCvk1PwIpsUhxQhigeYBFdW9B5vSTA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXPUwfrZDduQfP_BJhBUuMLFbpa7si4wjlm_pxzCzq4JiRu88-i05NRUATGCmDOlPj2IsvyibL0dN7zbdLrSzPGeDGPG6Ps7IszO6AMVrY_5nHo1noH60dIrUHDzY5M--By88wX-zh_w)

Inconsistent results: Some reviewers still experience headaches, sluggishness, or nausea the next day. Price per dose: Costs vary depending on where you buy (roughly $3 to $5 per dose depending on pack size and retailer).
